name: Comoros
summary_text: Comoros is dangerous for trans visitors. The 2020 Penal Code criminalises acts “contrary to morality or against nature” (2 years), enforced: two women were detained in June 2024 after asking an Islamic preacher to marry them, convicted in December 2024 (released for time served). No LGR; small conservative archipelago.

sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Not retrievable at research time (HTTP 403); the underlying Human Dignity Trust country profile documents that Comoros criminalises same-sex sexual activity (up to 3 years' imprisonment under the penal code).
NOTE: Not retrievable at research time (HTTP 401); the underlying Reuters report (Dec 2024) covers a couple in Comoros released after a same-sex sentencing verdict.

sources.title: Comoros - United States Department of State
sources.claim_summary: US State Department 2023 Human Rights Report for Comoros: official assessment including the SOGI section - same-sex conduct criminalised (Article 300), societal discrimination, and the December 2024 conviction of a lesbian couple.

US State Department 2010 Human Rights Report for Comoros: general human-rights baseline (poor prisons, restrictions on movement/press/religion, discrimination against women) with limited LGBT-specific content.

sources.title: Comoros | Outright International
sources.claim_summary: Outright International country overview (March 2026): Article 300 of the 2020 penal code punishes 'any act of a sexual nature that is contrary to public decency or against nature' with 6 months to 2 years and fines; no SOGISC protections, no legal gender recognition, no intersex protections; in 2022 a leaked video allegedly led to the first imprisonment for same-sex intimacy; in June 2024 two women were arrested after asking an Islamic preacher to marry them (convicted December 2024, sentenced to time served); the government repeatedly refuses UN decriminalisation recommendations.

sources.title: Comoros court convicts lesbian couple, sentences them to months in jail
sources.claim_summary: Washington Blade (Dec 2024): 'Comoros court convicts lesbian couple, sentences them to months in jail' — a court upholds convictions of two women for same-sex relations despite an earlier acquittal.
